summary:
FS.GG.Workspace.Template **0.20.1** (FS-GG/FS.GG.Templates) is published. Public installed acceptance exists only for creations with `--no-coordination`; creation with default coordination is not accepted. This supersedes the earlier owner-boundary record, which described the surface as eight configurations and seven selectors; the registry entry remains the schema authority for the full surface.

**Publication (2026-10-30):**
- Annotated tag `fs-gg-templates/v0.20.1` (`ff5caa76`) peels to the register commit `df896c4b` (Templates#815).
- Release run 41042757474 succeeded: route, pack, the release-route gate (register accepted payload `7c48b222`, provider floor, composition lanes) and `publish [org-publication-writer]` under the ADR-0097 lock.
- Payload identity `7c48b222...` with 620 entries. Root read the GitHub Release asset and the nuget.org archive independently: the nuget.org archive carries the same 620 entries plus only `.signature.p7s`, so its sole difference is the signature. The GitHub Packages feed returned 403 to Root, so that feed rests on the workflow readback receipt (`payloadExact` true, 620 entries) plus the identical release asset.

**Surface:** the four CLI workspace providers `typescript-cli`, `javascript-cli`, `rust-cli` and `go-cli` (typed catalog `providers/polyglot.catalog.json`, digest `40dd5a8f...`), now with the common project-knowledge composition (guide, schema, CI workflow and checker). The published 0.20.0 payloads lack that composition.

**Public installed acceptance, scoped to `--no-coordination` (#3010 Step 3, comment 6523620705):** Wizard 0.23.0, SDD CLI 2.5.3 and Governance CLI 1.15.0 were installed from nuget.org only, with an isolated configuration and fresh cache. Each of the four providers was created through the public Wizard with `--no-coordination` against `fs-gg-templates/v0.20.1`; each workspace's scaffold provenance pins the template sha and catalog `40dd5a8f`. Per provider: knowledge assets present, `doctor` coherent with no diagnostics, `knowledge check` and the generated checker after initialize, Governance Verify with all eight gates (build, lint, test, public-surface, package, security, evidence, release) and zero security findings. Five refusal controls (stale ref, bad digest in two variants, wrong policy, offline without pins, occupied target) exited nonzero on every provider, leaving the target byte-identical and no scratch. 85 of 85 checks passed after two retained harness-defect first runs (not product or tool defects). Receipts are in private custody; manifest digest `ea322f15...` and run summary `aa01a492...`.

**Default-coordination defect (comment 6523944130):** a read-only journey with default coordination (no `gh`, no tokens) found that Wizard 0.23.0 writes `securityObligations` into the SDD-owned `.fsgg/scaffold-provenance.json`. SDD 2.5.3's strict schema rejects it, so `doctor` reports `isCoherent:false` (`scaffold.provenanceMalformed`, Unknown property) on all four providers; removing the key gives `isCoherent:true`. The obligations were recorded as pending, never claimed satisfied, and `knowledge check` passed on all four. The coordination kit is fetched anonymously from the moving `main` ref, so it is unpinned and not reproducible; the kit observed matched `main@a9a6f77f` byte for byte. The Acceptance clause preserving coordination is not met. The repair (obligations in a Wizard-owned file, pinned kit ref, Wizard 0.23.1) is tracked in .github#4964; #3010 closes only after published 0.23.1 passes the four-provider default-coordination rerun with a coherent doctor.

**Limits:**
- The GitHub Packages feed bytes were not read directly (403).
- No reproducibility pack was made.
- Independent advisory-input custody is owed: the scanner databases were fetched by the same provisioning.
- Only Linux x64 on one contained carrier was exercised.

**Registry:** `registry/dependencies.yml` at the cited .github revision records version and package-version 0.20.1 (reconciled in .github#4955); a registry declaration is not feed or installed evidence on its own. Acceptance of 0.20.0 and earlier payloads remains historical at its original scope.
title: fs-gg-workspace-template 0.20.1: four CLI providers published; installed acceptance scoped to --no-coordination
